decisionsTitle: «În afara locurilor»: a registration that consumes no place and enters no public number
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02:** «Vreau și o bifă de „ascunde la numărare” per fiecare participant.» Asked what the tick should do, he chose: **outside the places** — the registration does not occupy one of the 150 and enters no public number, but has a declaration, a race number and appears on the list if the person ticked; for organizers, pacemakers and invited runners; set by the Administrator and written in the journal.

**What there was.** The only row left out of any count was a `TEST` registration (§30, `AGENTS.md` §12.6) — which behaves as a real one in the allocator and cannot exist in production. Nothing let the club seat its own runners or a guest without taking a place from the ones it announced.

**Decision: one column and one exclusion.** `registrations.outside_capacity boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false` (migration `0123_registration_outside_capacity`, expand only). The capacity formula (`AGENTS.md` §10.6) gains one explicit exclusion: `countOccupied` leaves a row marked «În afara locurilor» out of every bucket — confirmed, a declaration hold (lapsed or not), an open offer, a family's reservation — so `computeOccupied`, the public places, the free-place count and every refusal's numbers (§589) leave it out too. The condition is on this audited column alone; `kind` is in no new condition (a `TEST` row can be outside the places too, and is marked exactly as a real one). **Why not the TEST rule:** a test row must behave as a real one in the queue precisely so the queue can be rehearsed (§30); an outside row is the opposite — a real person whom the queue must not count — so it needed its own column, never a new meaning of `kind`.

**The allocator.** `allocateOrWaitlist` gives an outside row its place directly whatever the counts — never waitlisted for want of one, never refused by a full line — with the ordinary declaration deadline and email; the stale holds still expire and the line is still served first (`placeForNewcomer`), as in every capacity-changing transaction. `expireStaleHolds` never releases an outside declaration hold for somebody wanting a place (it holds no counted place; it expires at the start like any hold), and the maintenance scan does not select an event for one. `countEligibleWaitlisted` and `lockOldestWaitlisted` read no outside row, so `fillAvailableSpots` never offers it anything. No offer is ever outside the places: marking an open offer makes it a declaration hold at once (below). «Dă-i un loc acum» (§637) treats an outside row as it treats a family's reserved one: it needs no counted place, so the press seats it on a full event and lets no lapsed hold go for it (the review of 2026-10-02 found the rebase onto §637 refusing it a place it needs none of).

**Marking and unmarking** (`setOutsideCapacityByStaff`, the registration's page, «Locurile evenimentului» → «Pune în afara locurilor» / «Numără între locuri», a confirm dialog that says what the press does in that row's state). Administrator only (`canManageRegistrations`, asserted in the action, the admin service and the service); everything under the event lock after the stale holds expire **and the line is served** — `fillAvailableSpots` at once, as `placeForNewcomer` does, before any other read and before a press that changes nothing returns (the review of 2026-10-02: a kept declaration hold `expireStaleHolds` lets go because somebody waits is that person's place, and without the refill an unmarking took it, the waiting runner offered nothing — `AGENTS.md` §10.6's «offered that place in the same transaction») — with the audit row `registration.outside_capacity_changed` (`from`, `to`, the state, and the state after when it moved) in the same transaction:
- a row holding a counted place (confirmed, a declaration, an offer, a family's live reservation): the place is released to the count and the usual refill follows — with «Da» the first in line is offered it, with «Nu» it stays free for the organizer (§615); a confirmed row or a declaration hold keeps its state, number and emails;
- a `WAITLISTED` row leaves the line and is given a place outside the places at once, through the one allocator: `PENDING_DECLARATION` with the ordinary deadline and the declaration email (the dialog says so). This is the first new transition, `WAITLISTED -> PENDING_DECLARATION`, allowed only for an outside row: the allocator's `fromStatuses` excludes `WAITLISTED` otherwise, so a counted place still reaches the line only as an offer (`AGENTS.md` §10.5 amended);
- a `WAITLIST_OFFERED` row the same (the review of 2026-10-02, round two, below): the place its offer held is released and refilled, and the row becomes a `PENDING_DECLARATION` hold with the ordinary deadline and the declaration email — the second new transition, `WAITLIST_OFFERED -> PENDING_DECLARATION`, guarded on the column the same way;
- a row waiting for its address: applies when the address is confirmed;
- unmarking a row that would then hold a counted place: only while `computeOccupied(counts) < capacity` under the lock, counted after the line was served — so it takes only a place nobody in line is owed — else §589's `NoFreePlaceError` and its sentence; the row then takes the place;
- a cancelled or expired row, or any row of an event not scheduled: the flag is read, never changed;
- **a restart clears it.** A cancelled or expired outside row the person restarts through the form (`carriedFields`) comes back counted, its end written to the journal as `registration.outside_capacity_changed` with no actor, `from: true`, `to: false`, `restarted: true`. The mark is an Administrator's act at a moment, and a seat beyond the announced places is given only by an Administrator acting at that time; kept, a restart would have seated a person on a full event without anybody choosing it, and the club could not clear it beforehand (the verb does not change an ended row). The club marks the new cycle again if it still wants to.

**The counts.** Public: `readPublicPlaces`/`publicFill` (`taken`, `confirmed`, `kept`), the places line, the free places, «Cine vine (N)» and «N confirmați — M cu numele afișat», the in-progress count and the others' «în curs de confirmare» leave outside rows out. The person's row stays in the table when they ticked, with no public marker; an unticked outside runner is not even a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row. Under the table, only while such a row is there, one sentence: «Organizatorii și invitații clubului apar în tabel fără să fie numărați: numerele de mai sus numără locurile.» The cached start-list counts gained `"outside"` in their keys with the new shape. Backoffice: the «Înscrieri» badge's `withPlace`/`confirmed` leave them out and the tooltip's event line gains «, N în afara locurilor» above zero; the registrations list's summary strip gains the pill and filter «În afara locurilor: N» (`outside=1`, a link like the state pills, §626; the strip's counts stay blind to it) and each row a chip; the event's «Înscrierile primite» says «în afara locurilor: N» beside the occupied places; the CSV and the spreadsheet gain «Outside the places» as their last column, and the export follows the pill (`outside=1`), as it follows every other filter on the list: the file is the rows on screen. The queue panel's figures were already the allocator's and needed no word. «Când se pierde un loc» (§635, `readPlaceDeadlines`) counts no outside row among the held places, the lapsed ones, the offers or a family's reservations — it holds no place to lose — and the automatic emails' forecast (`forecast.ts`) foresees no offer to the line and no «locul tău a expirat» at an outside hold's lapse, which the job never sends, while the row's own last call stays foreseen, as the job sends it. The desk shows them like anybody. The «Ghid» gains the Administrator's task «Un loc în afara locurilor: organizatori, pacemakeri, invitați».

**An open offer marked «În afara locurilor» (the review of 2026-10-02, round two).** `setOutsideCapacityByStaff` seated a `WAITLISTED` row but left a `WAITLIST_OFFERED` one a live offer with the line's short deadline, and `expireStaleHolds` lapses every offer at its deadline (§10.5) — so when the deadline passed the invited runner's registration ended `EXPIRED` with `WAITLIST_OFFER_LAPSED`, and the job's offer clause woke for it: against «no stale-hold sweep releases its hold», `AGENTS.md` §10.6 («it expires at the start like any hold») and the dialog's «Starea, numărul și emailurile rămân». Now marking an open offer seats it exactly as a waiting row is seated: the place the offer held is released to the count and refilled as the event's setting says (`fillAvailableSpots`, run before the allocator so the press's own count of offers is right), then the one allocator makes the row a `PENDING_DECLARATION` hold with the ordinary declaration deadline (the participation window's, for a race still far off, §104) and queues `COMPLETE_DECLARATION`, the hold's starting email (§513). The new transition `WAITLIST_OFFERED -> PENDING_DECLARATION` is guarded on the column as `WAITLISTED -> PENDING_DECLARATION` is: the allocator's `fromStatuses` excludes both origins unless the row is outside, so an offer of a counted place is still signed, cancelled or lapses. The offer's email, if still queued and never tried, is withdrawn — after the allocator, because while it is queued an offer past its stored deadline is not lapsed (§520) and the allocator's own sweep must still see it so — as «Dă-i un loc acum» withdraws a verification email (§637). The offer's link is replaced by the declaration's when that email is rendered: `issueActionToken` takes `alsoReplaces`, and the renderer passes `WAITLIST_OFFER` for a declaration link minted while the registration holds a declaration — both links open the same page and sign the same registration, so one stays working and the offer's page says a newer email has it (§619's «replaced», across those two purposes of one registration; the same holds for an offer that ended before the registration was restarted, whose link could otherwise still sign the new hold). The dialog says so in that state («În locul ofertei, {name} primește acum un loc în afara locurilor: emailul «{message}», cu termenul obișnuit. Locul ofertei se eliberează.»), and the Ghid's steps name the offer beside the waiting list.

**Why not keep the offer until the start** (leaving outside rows out of the lapsed-offers sweep and the job's offer clause, the review's alternative). An offer is a promise to the line with the line's deadline, and its email states that deadline and that length (§419); kept past it, the page and the email would name a deadline that no longer binds, and a third kind of hold — an offer that never lapses — would enter every reader of offers (the forecast, «Când se pierde un loc», the journey, the desk). A declaration hold outside the places is already what every other outside row holds, and every reader treats it so.

**A TEST row's dialog names no email in its body either** (§384, the same review). For a TEST row the bold email line was already dropped, but the waiting row's body still said the person gets the email «{message}». The waiting and the offered bodies now have a TEST form that names the declaration to sign and no email («… un loc în afara locurilor: declarația de semnat, cu termenul obișnuit.»), as the bold line does.

**Not changed.** The `TEST` kind and its rule; the race numbers' assignment (an outside confirmed row draws a number as any confirmed); the emails; the public list's disclosure gates (§396, §628, §634); the Organizer's rights (reads the chip and the pill, changes nothing, §289).

**Refused.**
- **Hiding the row from the public list.** The list is a disclosure the person chose (§143); hiding a ticked name because the club did not count them would make the tick mean something else. An outside runner appears exactly as any ticked confirmed runner does.
- **A second capacity** (a club reserve inside the formula, §615's rejected alternative). It would change the one formula every count reads; an exclusion on an audited row changes nobody else's count.
- **Letting the Organizer mark.** It moves a place, which is a change to registrations the Organizer reads and does not make (§289).

**Tests.** `tests/integration/registrations/outside-capacity.test.ts` (new): a full event still seats an outside row and the places line and `publicFill` do not move; an unmarking with a kept hold released for a waiting runner — the runner is offered it and the unmark refused, or, with a place left over, the runner offered first and the unmark given the other; a press that changes nothing still offers a lapsed offer's place to the next runner; «Dă-i un loc acum» seats an outside row on a full event while a counted one is refused; the export with `outside=1`; the forecast and «Când se pierde un loc» blind to an outside hold; a restart clearing the mark, with its journal row; the badge leaving an outside row's family reservation out of «cu loc»; an outside confirmed row in no public confirmed count, keeping its number; no stale-hold sweep releases an outside hold while the counted lapsed one still goes; marking a confirmed row on a full event — offered to the first in line on «Da», free on «Nu»; marking a waiting row seats it with the declaration email; marking an offered runner whose offer email left makes it a declaration hold with the ordinary deadline and one `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` queued, the line offered the freed place, the audit row's `statusAfter`, the offer's link replaced by the declaration's at render, and past the offer's deadline neither `findEventsNeedingMaintenance` nor `expireStaleHolds` touches it; marking one whose offer email is still queued, its stored deadline already behind, seats it and withdraws that email; unmarking refused when full with §589's numbers, allowed when a place is free; the audit rows; the Organizer refused; a cancelled row refused; a TEST row outside; the public start list's counts (named, outside named, the anonymous); the summary strip, the list filter and the badge's split and tooltip line. `tests/concurrency/capacity.test.ts` gains a case: one counted place free, ten newcomers and an unmarking racing for it on separate connections — the counted places end at the capacity whichever wins. Updated: the state machine's named transitions (22), the TEST-row email gates (nine on the registration page beside §637's, and a new case: the waiting and offered bodies for a TEST row name no email), the CSV and spreadsheet column positions, the privacy suite's others counts, the confirm-first classification of the new action, the TEST-row email gate on the registration page. Edited, not run: `tests/e2e/terms-on-registration.spec.ts` (the export's last column).

**Consequences.** Migration `0123_registration_outside_capacity`; `db/schema/registrations.ts`; `registrations/repository.ts` (`countOccupied`, `listPlaceCountInstants`, `countEligibleWaitlisted`, `lockOldestWaitlisted`, `lapsedDeclarationHoldsToRelease`, `findEventsNeedingMaintenance`, `isOutsideCapacity`, `writeOutsideCapacity`, `countOutsideCapacity`, the start list's counts), `service.ts` (`allocateOrWaitlist`, `setOutsideCapacityByStaff`, `givePlaceNowByStaff`, the restart's `carriedFields`), `notifications/forecast.ts`, `admin-repository.ts#readPlaceDeadlines`, `domain/state-machine.ts` (two transitions), `admin-service.ts#setOutsideCapacity`, `action-tokens/repository.ts#issueActionToken` (`alsoReplaces`), `notifications/render.ts` (the declaration link replacing the offer link), `domain/link-status.ts` (its comment), `admin-repository.ts` (the rows, the filter, the summary), `nav-count.ts`, `csv.ts`, `workbook.ts`, `ui/SummaryStrip.tsx`, `domain/summary-filter-links.ts`; `public-cache/reads.ts`; `events/ui/StartList.tsx`; the registrations list, the registration's page, the event's page, `BackofficeShell.tsx`, the export route, `admin/registrations/actions.ts#setOutsideCapacityAction`; audit action `registration.outside_capacity_changed`; `messages/{ro,en}.json`. Docs: `AGENTS.md` §10.5 (both transitions), §10.6, §15.11 (verb 6, and §637's line); CLAUDE.md's no-overbooking row and its staff-verbs row («Nothing else» now names the Administrator's mark); `BUSINESS.md` BR-BUS-034; `SETUP.md` §39. No dependency.
changelogLine: - **«În afara locurilor» for organizers, pacemakers and invited runners** — an Administrator marks a registration on its page and it takes none of the event's places: a declaration, a race number and a row on the public list if the person ticked, in no public number; a place it held goes back to the line, a waiting runner or an open offer is seated at once with the ordinary declaration deadline, and the list, the badge, the editor and the export count them apart. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A registration marked «În afara locurilor» (`registrations.outside_capacity`) is in no term of the capacity formula in any state — confirmed, a declaration hold, an open offer or a family's reservation; the allocator gives it a place directly whatever the counts and never waitlists or refuses it for want of one, `fillAvailableSpots` never offers it anything and no stale-hold sweep releases its hold for somebody waiting; every mark or unmark serves the line first under the event lock (`fillAvailableSpots` after the stale holds expire, even when the press changes nothing), marking a row that holds a counted place releases it and the ordinary refill follows, marking a `WAITLISTED` row, or a `WAITLIST_OFFERED` one, gives it a declaration hold at once with the ordinary deadline and one `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` queued (an offer's queued email never tried withdrawn), so past the offer's deadline `expireStaleHolds` leaves it `PENDING_DECLARATION` and `findEventsNeedingMaintenance` does not select its event for it — `WAITLISTED` and `WAITLIST_OFFERED -> PENDING_DECLARATION` only for an outside row, and unmarking a row that would hold a counted place is refused with `NoFreePlaceError` unless `occupied < capacity` once the line is served — so a hold released for a waiting runner is offered to them, never taken by the unmarked row — so two connections racing for the last place while a row is unmarked never end above capacity; a cancelled or expired outside row restarted through the form comes back counted, the mark cleared and journalled; only the column is a condition, `kind` none (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The registrations list's summary strip shows «În afara locurilor: N» while any real registration is marked so, a link that filters the list to them (`outside=1`, kept beside the state in force, the strip's counts unchanged by it), each such row wears a chip, the «Înscrieri» badge's «cu loc» and confirmed figures leave them out while the tooltip's event line ends «, N în afara locurilor», the event's «Înscrierile primite» says «în afara locurilor: N» beside the occupied places, and the CSV and spreadsheet end with «Outside the places» and, with the pill pressed (`outside=1`), hold only those rows; «Când se pierde un loc» counts no outside row among the held places, the lapsed ones or the offers; only an Administrator marks or unmarks, from the registration's page, each change audited as `registration.outside_capacity_changed` with from and to — the Organizer is refused (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A confirmed registration «În afara locurilor» whose person ticked the list appears in the table like any ticked confirmed runner, with no public marker, and is left out of «Cine vine (N)», the «N confirmați — M cu numele afișat» line, the in-progress count and the places line; an unticked one is not even a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row; while such a row is in the table the note under it adds one sentence saying the club's organizers and invited runners appear without being counted; the disclosure gates are unchanged (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Dă-i un loc acum» on a registration «În afara locurilor» gives it its place whatever the counts — it needs no counted free place, so a full event does not refuse it and no lapsed declaration hold goes for it — while a counted row on the same full event is still refused with §589's sentence (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

/admin/emails foresees no offer to the next in line and no lapse email at the deadline of a declaration hold «În afara locurilor», which the maintenance job never releases for anybody, and keeps that row's own last call as foreseen (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A declaration link minted for a registration that holds a declaration replaces that registration's live waiting-list offer link: the offer link is refused as `SUPERSEDED`, its `superseded_by_token_id` names the declaration link and its page says a newer email has the working link, so an open offer seated «În afara locurilor» leaves one working link to sign with (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The «Pune în afara locurilor» dialog for a waiting row or an open offer names the declaration's email «{message}» and the bold email line for a real row, and for a TEST row neither — its body names the declaration to sign and no email (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
